adm.tap_hint: Tap an empty time to add an appointment. Tap an appointment to manage it.
adm.move_hint: Tap the new time for {name} (in any column).
adm.place_anyway: Outside working hours or busy. Place it anyway? (Overlaps are never allowed.)
adm.auto: Automatic messages (reminders, evening list, waitlist offers, expiry)
adm.name: Name
adm.bad_client: Check the name and phone number.
adm.overlaps: Blocked. {n} booked appointment(s) overlap, please check them.
adm.staff_note: Each person has their own calendar and hours. Customers choose a person only when two or more can do the service.
adm.staff_only_hint: Only owners and masters see and book it; clients never do.
adm.does_note: Customers only see a person for services they do. New services are on for everyone.
adm.hours_note: A gap between two intervals is a break. Days off are set in the calendar (tap a name).
adm.already_linked: You are already linked to another staff member.
adm.has_future: This person has upcoming appointments. Move or cancel them first.
adm.last_staff: At least one person must stay active.
adm.svc_note: Duration is what the client sees. The buffer is extra time reserved for preparation and cleaning.
adm.step_note: Start times are offered every N minutes within working hours.
adm.buffer_close_note: Off: the last booking may finish its buffer after closing time. On: the whole reservation, buffer included, must end by closing.
adm.client_view_note: Book as a customer to test what clients see.
adm.tg_note: Gives this person access to the staff app and their own calendar. Ask them to send /getmyid to the bot to get the number.
adm.no_calendar: No calendar is linked to you yet. Ask the owner to link your Telegram ID.
adm.names_note: Fill in at least one language. Clients see their own language, or English / Czech if one is missing.
adm.hidden_only: Has appointments, so it was hidden instead
adm.svc_empty: No services yet. Add the first one below.
adm.addon_note: Add-ons can be added to any service.
adm.admin_note: Full control: all calendars, staff, services and settings. Without it, this person only sees their own calendar.
adm.self_demote: You cannot remove your own administrator access.
adm.loyalty_note: Completed visits count. When a client reaches the number below, you approve a percentage discount for their next booking.
adm.has_history: Past bookings exist, so this person cannot be deleted. Switch Active off instead.
adm.bc_note: Sent to every client who has used the bot and has not unsubscribed. Every message has one button: Unsubscribe, which becomes Subscribe again. About 25 messages go out per minute.
adm.bc_none: There is nobody to send to yet.
adm.bc_dup: This exact message was already sent in the last hour.
adm.bc_many: Three offers were already sent today.
adm.bc_changed: The audience changed. Check the number and tap again.
adm.rem_note: Reminders respect the client's quiet hours (21:00–08:00) and move earlier, never later.
adm.rem1_warn: Shorter than the cancel cutoff: this reminder will not offer Reschedule or Cancel.
adm.rem_un: Alert me when the first reminder is unanswered
adm.agenda_empty: Also send it when there are none
adm.waitlist: Offer freed times to the waiting list
adm.backup_nokey: Backups are OFF: BACKUP_KEY is missing on the server.
adm.ad_days: Ads: at most one per client every … days
adm.auto_off: OFF: nothing is sent automatically. Check /status → Preview next 24 h, then switch it on.
vch.note: Create a voucher only after you have received the payment. The code is shown once.
vch.partial_hint: The remaining balance stays on the voucher.
vch.once: The code is shown only now. Copy it or share it.
vch.replayed: This voucher was already created. Its code was shown once and cannot be shown again.
vch.no_link: The bot's link is not known yet: the recipient sends the code to the bot.
vch.saved_hint: Saved. If nothing downloads, use the copy sent to your chat.
vch.in_chat: The QR was also sent to your chat with the bot.
vch.card_scan: Scan the QR code to open it in Telegram
vch.terms_hint: Shown to the recipient with a new voucher. Leave empty for the built-in text. {until} is replaced by the expiry date.
vch.too_big: The card is too large to send (over 1 MB).
vch.reissue_confirm: Tap again: old code stops, new one is created
vch.reissue_reserved: A booking holds this voucher. Cancel or complete it first.
adm.after_note: Aftercare text and the fill suggestion are set per service. The fill nudge and the review request are commercial messages: they carry the label and an Unsubscribe button. Visits of staff-only services never trigger any of this. Leave the review link empty to switch review requests off.
adm.fill_nudge: Fill nudge (when due, without a new booking)
adm.autocomplete_h: … this many hours after the visit ends
adm.review_url: Google review link (https, pasted from Google)
adm.review_gap: At most one request per client every (days)
adm.aftercare_note: Sent after the visit is completed. Empty text = no aftercare message for that language (another language is used if it has one). Fill days: the suggested time for the next visit (0 = no suggestion and no nudge).
adm.preview_note: Sends the aftercare, fill-nudge and review-request messages to YOUR chat, exactly as a client would see them, each marked PREVIEW. Buttons do nothing. Nothing is booked or sent to a client.
ln.title: 🚀 Launch checklist · {done} of {total} required done
ln.ready: Everything required is done. You can open the studio to clients. 🎉
ln.notready: Tap an open item to see how to fix it.
ln.service: At least one public service with a price
ln.aftercare: Aftercare text and fill days on lash services
ln.secrets: Backup and voucher keys on the server
ln.staff: The master's own Telegram linked as staff
ln.f_studio: Mini App → Settings → Studio info: studio name, address, map pin (latitude and longitude), your Telegram username or Instagram, and the cancellation policy text.
ln.f_service: Mini App → Services: add the services with a price; on a lash service fill in the aftercare text and "Fill after (days)".
ln.f_staff: Mini App → Team: open your card, set the working hours, and link it to your own Telegram.
ln.f_privacy: Read the privacy notice as clients see it (Settings in the Mini App, or the first booking in the chat). When it is right, tap the button below.
ln.f_secrets: Add BACKUP_KEY and VOUCHER_PEPPER to the server .env file (never inside the app) and keep a copy of both in your password manager. /status shows what is missing.
ln.f_automation: Reminders, the evening agenda and waitlist offers stay silent until automation is ON. Turn it on when you are ready.
ln.f_review: Optional. Paste the review link from your Google Business profile into Mini App → Settings → After the visit.
ln.f_ai: Optional. In the chat: /v staff (only staff can try it) or /v on (clients too).
ln.f_pin_note: Open your place in Google Maps, long-press the spot and copy the two numbers (for example 50.0755 and 14.4378).
ln.f_policy_note: Shown to clients at booking. Leave a language empty to use the built-in text.
adm.guide_note: The same text as /navod in the chat. In Czech for now.
ln.f_address_note: The exact address (and the map pin) is sent only to a client with a confirmed booking.
ln.f_area_note: E.g. "Praha 4 – Nusle". Do not write the street here: texts that contain the exact address are refused (a safety net, not a guarantee).
adm.adr_footer: Default follows the studio rule. Always: released automatically once the booking is confirmed. Never: only by hand.
adm.adr_unreachable: This client cannot be reached in Telegram
